Freeze and execute exactly this determination, which needs no new HTTP request, no new corpus, no browser, no Docker and no credential. (a) State the COLD COUNTERFACTUAL arm explicitly as E_cold = Cmiss*p - the same expression with the carried state absent - because the published model prices only the branch an agent actually takes and never prices the alternative, and a break-even is meaningless without the alternative. (b) Derive the per-task saving and the break-even with the algebra shown, f* = Cwrite / (E_cold - E_warm) where E_warm is the Eq. (1) value, and state explicitly which accounting convention is assumed for the printed term Cwrite*N - is the write cost charged once in total, or once per reuse? - because that single convention moves f* by orders of magnitude and the paper does not disambiguate it. If f* is finite and below an operational bound across the published parameter range, then a measured f* IS reportable in this class, its absence in two Intel runs is a REPORTING-PRACTICE finding, and one properly designed census is worth funding.
